P01.rationale: The founder's portrait is a large, prominent anchor in the bottom section of the page.

P05.rationale: While there is only one client profile rather than multiple case studies, it is clearly framed and named at a meaningful size.

P07.rationale: There are no press logos or review grids present; the 'social proof' element is limited to the founder's name and title.

P10.rationale: The headline typography is oversized and acts as a dominant decorative element within the layout.

P11.rationale: A specific data visualization (the '25-30%' statistic) is clearly bound to real numbers regarding costs.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text and graphics.

P13.rationale: A subtle paper texture is visible in the background, providing atmosphere rather than flat blankness.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos used on this page to require treatment or text readability checks.

P16.rationale: The founder is depicted in a realistic setting that implies the use of devices and tools for his work.

N07.rationale: The imagery appears specific to a real business context rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content blocks.

N10.rationale: Text sits on clean backgrounds or distinct colored blocks without awkward inset gaps over busy photos.
